integrity: Proof given for all n>=3 and k>=2, corroborated by direct finite exhaustive and independent dynamic-program checks. These finite checks are not substituted for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The 2018 cycle minimum-weight formula and the k=1 minimum-total-dominating-set counts are previously known; the result refines these by classifying and counting all optimizers by positive support for k>=2. Historical priority for the refinement remains subject to external expert review. No extension to noncycles or automorphism-quotiented counts.
title: Support-refined census of optimal total \(\{k\}\)-dominating functions on cycles
